# Two CAD expense lines on one USD bill, one of them on an account held to
# thousandths.
#
# The fuel line carries 1.82 CAD for 1.30 USD and the parts line 5.00 for
# 3.57. Their ratios differ in the third decimal because each was rounded to
# its own unit — which is why the tool pools them rather than judging them
# against each other: 6.82 CAD over 4.87 USD is the cost of the USD this bill
# brought in, whichever order the splits are read in.
#
# What this fixture produces: one cost basis, and figures printed at the unit
# each split is held to. The fuel account is kept to thousandths, so its line
# reads 1.820 and the report names the unit — nothing else tells a reader that
# account apart from an ordinary CAD one.
#
# The figure stated is a whole number of cents, because that is all a file may
# state: a booked amount is judged against the currency however fine the
# account is. 1.819 stood here before, and an amount finer than the currency
# was stored at the account's unit while its value was rounded to the
# currency's — two figures for one sum on the same split.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fuel
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Parts
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "A US bill whose two CAD lines were converted differently"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Fuel 1.82 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "1.30"
	Expenses:Parts 5.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "3.57"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD -4.87 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-4.87"
